title: Reach-Avoid Differential game with Reachability Analysis for UAVs: A decomposition approach
abstract: arXiv:2512.22793v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reach-avoid (RA) games have significant applications in security and defense, particularly for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). These problems are inherently challenging due to the need to consider obstacles, consider the adversarial nature of opponents, ensure optimality, and account for nonlinear dynamics. Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) reachability analysis has emerged as a powerful tool for tackling these challenges; however, while it has been applied to games involving two spatial dimensions, directly extending this approach to three spatial dimensions is impossible due to high dimensionality. On the other hand, alternative approaches for solving RA games lack the generality to consider games with three spatial dimensions involving agents with non-trivial system dynamics. translated_title: 基于可达性分析的无人机可达-规避微分博弈：一种分解方法
translated_abstract: 可达-规避（RA）博弈在安全与国防领域有着重要应用，特别是对无人机（UAV）而言。由于需要考虑障碍物、对手之间的对抗性质、确保最优性并处理非线性动力学，这类问题本质上极具挑战性。汉密尔顿-雅可比（HJ）可达性分析已成为应对这些挑战的有力工具；然而，尽管该方法已被应用于涉及两个空间维度的博弈，但由于维度过高，无法直接将其扩展到三个空间维度。另一方面，求解RA博弈的其他替代方法缺乏足够的通用性，难以处理涉及具有非平凡系统动力学智能体的三维空间博弈。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新颖的降维框架，通过将问题分解为一个水平RA子博弈和一个垂直RA子博弈来降低维度。我们……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种新颖的降维分解框架，将三维无人机可达-规避微分博弈分解为水平与垂直两个子博弈，从而使HJ可达性分析能够有效求解高维RA博弈问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel dimensionality-reduction framework that decomposes the 3D UAV reach-avoid differential game into a horizontal and a vertical sub-game, enabling HJ reachability analysis to solve high-dimensional RA game problems.
